name: singlet_integration_batch_corrected_embedding
title: Batch-corrected joint embedding
description: Integrates cells from several batches (donors, studies, protocols) of one dataset and writes a batch-corrected embedding, a batch-balanced graph (bbknn) or corrected expression (combat). The default harmony corrects the PCA embedding; scvi and scanvi train a conditional model on raw counts. Needs obsm/X_pca, var/highly_variable, a batch column with at least two levels, and layers/counts for scvi and scanvi. Does not score integration quality; do not use it on a single batch or to remove a biological condition that must be kept.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

method.description: Integration method. harmony (default) corrects the PCA embedding; scvi and scanvi train on raw counts; bbknn writes a graph only; combat corrects expression.

batch_key.description: obs column holding the batch label; at least two levels and no missing values.

n_hvg.description: Number of highly variable genes kept, taken in var/hvg_rank order among genes flagged in var/highly_variable.

n_pcs.description: Embedding width d: PCs read from obsm/X_pca (harmony, bbknn, seurat_*) or PCA width for fastmnn, scanorama, combat. Ignored by liger, scvi, scanvi.

theta.description: Diversity penalty per batch variable; 0 disables the diversity term.

sigma.description: Width of the soft k-means clusters (entropy scale).

nclust.description: Number of soft clusters K; null uses min(round(N/30), 100).

max_iter.description: Maximum outer iterations; stops earlier when the objective converges.

alpha.description: Ridge scale: lambda is alpha times the expected cluster-batch count.

seurat.description: Options for methods seurat_cca and seurat_rpca.

k_filter.description: Neighbours for anchor filtering; null applies no filtering.

k_weight.description: Anchors that weight each cell's correction vector.

scvi.description: Options for methods scvi and scanvi.

n_layers.description: Hidden layers in encoder and decoder.

max_epochs.description: Training epochs; null uses min(round(400*20000/N), 400), at least 1.

label_key.description: obs column with partial cell-type labels; required for scanvi.

unlabeled_category.description: Value in label_key that marks unlabelled cells; required for scanvi.

seed.description: Random seed for initialisation, minibatches and approximate neighbour search; recorded with the output.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running or writing.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members of this method instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. obsm/X_integrated_harmony. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: For completed runs: method, input_layer, batch_key, n_batches, n_cells, n_hvg_used, n_pcs, device, seed, warnings. Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
